audit.whatIsWrong: All seven phases[N].side read "Skill" while content win[0..6] read Lux, Lux, then Aurora five times — exactly packet.levelChart.
audit.why: The content chart matches the kit. Every Lux ability out-ranges Aurora: Light Binding 1175, Prismatic Barrier 1150, Lucent Singularity 1100, against Aurora's 900 Q and 825 E. Levels 1-2 are therefore a tax Aurora pays. From level 3 the full pattern exists and Light Binding's flat 10 seconds becomes a punishable gap, and from 6 Between Worlds crosses the ground her poke depends on. 53.29% over 1809 games fits a lane that starts behind and stays ahead after.
audit.corrected: phases[0..1].side = Lux at 4/10, phases[2..6].side = Aurora at 6/10, every affected why rewritten in the same proposal. content win[] needed no edit.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2] and late named Lich Bane, which is not in this page's own itemization line, and the spike story carried no numbers.
audit.why: report[8] prescribes Luden's into Sorcerer's, then Shadowflame and Rabadon's. Shadowflame is the one item both fields agree on. The real ladder is readable from cooldowns: Light Binding flat 10, Lucent Singularity 10 down to 8, Prismatic Barrier 12 down to 10, Final Spark 60/50/40.
audit.corrected: Lich Bane dropped in favour of Shadowflame, which the page already prescribes; the spike ladder rebuilt on those cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two stated interactions are wrong and two real ones were missing. The page said to 'minion-block' Light Binding so 'her combo never starts', and spikes[1] said Between Worlds dodges Final Spark 'by phasing the instant she casts'. Aurora's E was again called a 'knockback-slow', and spikes[3] and content mid credited Aurora's Q with mobility it does not have.
audit.why: enemyKit Q: 'binds and deals damage to up to two enemy units' — one minion in the path absorbs one of two binds, so it does not stop the spell. ownerKit R text is a leap, a shockwave, a slow zone and a teleport across that zone; nothing in it grants untargetability, so 'phasing' out of Final Spark is not sourceable — repositioning out of the beam is. ownerKit Q is a missile plus a recast that draws curses back; it is not a gap-close or a reset. ownerKit E damages and slows, then Aurora hops backward. Missing: enemyKit W is a shield that absorbs the front of your burst, and enemyKit E carries revealsStealth, which directly answers Across the Veil's invisibility.
audit.corrected: Light Binding restated as binding up to two units so a single minion does not stop it; Final Spark handled by moving out of the beam while she gathers; Q described as missile and recast; E as a slow that self-peels; and both the shield and the stealth reveal now appear on the page.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit at all (catalogue defect 3).
audit.why: Light Binding is a flat 10 seconds at every rank, which is the single most useful number in this lane because it is the window the whole page tells you to step up in. Lucent Singularity is 10 at rank 1, Final Spark 60/50/40.
audit.corrected: All three now carry digits, with ranges attached.

audit.whatIsWrong: Lux was called he/his in tldr, tradeGood, tradeBad, ahead, loading, breakdown.wave, dosFull[0].t, dontsFull[0].t, dontsFull[1].t, phases[0].why, phases[5].why and four report entries.
audit.why: champ-gender.js lists lux as female; the owner is 'you', so every third-person pronoun on the page is Lux.
audit.corrected: Fixed, with the sentences regrounded in her kit rather than pronoun-swapped in place.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[3] claimed 'her cooldowns are longer relative to your uptime'. content wants.you[1] told the reader to survive levels 1-2 'by trading in melee stance', which is not a thing Aurora has.
audit.why: Lucent Singularity is 10 seconds falling to 8; Aurora's E is 15 falling to 11. Lux's E is on the shorter cooldown, so the claim inverts the truth. The thing that actually changes at levels 4-5 is her mana: Lucent Singularity costs 70 to 110 per cast.
audit.corrected: whys[3] rewritten to the mana cost, which is the real constraint; wants.you[1] rewritten to farming under tower and dodging.

notes: All seven chart rows read 'Skill' in the full layer while content win[] already matched packet.levelChart (Lux, Lux, then Aurora x5); flipped the sides with paired ratings and rewritten whys in one proposal. Two stated interactions were wrong and both would change how someone plays. First, the page told the reader to minion-block Light Binding so 'her combo never starts' — Riot's text says it binds up to two enemy units, so a single minion absorbs one bind and the spell keeps going. Second, spikes[1] said Between Worlds dodges Final Spark 'by phasing'; Aurora's R text is a leap, a shockwave, a slow zone and a teleport across it, with no untargetability anywhere, so I rewrote it as moving out of the beam while she gathers. content mid and spikes[3] also credited Aurora's Q with being a 'gap-close/reset' — it is a missile plus a recast. Newly on the page: Prismatic Barrier absorbs the front of your burst (12s at rank 1), and Lucent Singularity reveals stealth, which is the direct answer to Across the Veil and had never been mentioned. whys[3] claimed her cooldowns are longer than yours, which is backwards — her E is 10 down to 8 against your 15 down to 11 — so I replaced it with the mana cost, which is the real constraint at 4-5. wants.you[1] told the reader to trade 'in melee stance', which Aurora does not have. breakdown.cooldowns had no digit. Fifteen misgendered fields fixed. Lich Bane appeared in spikes[2] and late while report[8] prescribes Luden's, Sorcerer's, Shadowflame and Rabadon's; I moved both to Shadowflame, which the page already names. packet.suspectNames flags 'Light Binding-' and 'Lucent Singularity-' in spikes[2] — those are false positives caused by hyphenation in a combo string, not wrong names, and the rewrite removes the hyphens anyway. The page also uses 'Twin Drift' and 'The Weirding' for Aurora's Q and E; the kit file carries no ability names for Aurora so I could not verify either and avoided both. | COHERENCE: 1 chart edit(s) withdrawn — they moved the row to the enemy while leaving the phase why describing the owner winning it. Chart authority is an open question, so the label was reverted rather than the prose rewritten. Re-propose only as a side+why pair.
